Air enters in a compressor operating at steady state at a pressure of 1 bar, a temperature of 290 K, and a velocity of 6 m/s through an inlet with an area of $0 . 1 \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 }$ At the exit, the pressure is 7 bar, the temperature is 450 K and the velocity is 2m/s. Heat transfer from the compressor to its surroundings occurs at a rate of 180 kJ/min. Employing the ideal gas model, calculate the power input to the compressor in kW. If the change in kinetic energy from inlet to exit were neglected, evaluate the compressor power in kW, keeping all the data unchanged. (Use 1 bar= 100 KPa)
